4,492 likes, 36 comments - earthpix on October 21, 2026: "Inside Hotel Monteleone in New Orleans’ French Quarter, the Carousel Bar has been slowly turning since 1949. Its 25 seats make one full rotation every 15 minutes, so guests see the room change while they sip.⁠
⁠
The hotel has welcomed literary legends like Ernest Hemingway, Tennessee Williams, and Truman Capote. ⁠
⁠
By: @hotelmonteleone".
